_ai_assisted: AI-assisted: protocol structure regenerated with Codex under Edu decisions for #137; reviewed by Edu. Adapted with Codex for Edu decisions on #191; reviewed by Edu.
_integration_status: Activated for confirmed numerical findings. Immediate clinical-priority entry before measurement confirmation remains a separate owner integration; no numerical finding automatically establishes urgency.

w_red_flags.text: In either eye: a new gap in vision, distortion in the centre, needed lens strength unavailable, sudden vision loss, severe eye pain, or severe headache with signs of a nerve or brain problem?
w_red_flags.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, SANS, 2024 [5]; SANS consensus, 2026 [6]; Team triage guide [P]

w_notify.text: Notify the crew medical officer. Together, agree on your check-ups and who is responsible for them.
w_notify.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; Team triage guide, SANS, watch: initial action [P]

w_acuity.text: With your clinician, compare vision with prescribed lenses to each eye's pre-flight reference; review eye scans and tests of your whole field of vision if available. Missing or invalid tests are not normal.
w_acuity.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; Team triage guide, SANS, watch: initial action [P]

w_correction.text: Use only prescribed lenses; follow sleep and habitat rules. Clearer vision does not prove swelling is gone; lower-body suction, thigh bands, supplements and acetazolamide (medicine) are for clinicians or research.
w_correction.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, SANS, 2024 [5]; SANS consensus, 2026 [6]

w_end.text: Keep the follow-up plan agreed with your clinician; no medicine is proven to reverse these spaceflight eye changes. Do not start medicines, pressure-changing treatments or invasive eye procedures from this app.
w_end.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, SANS, 2024 [5]; Team triage guide [P] Pharmaceutical limits: PDF p. 2, sources [5,6]; NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, printed pp. 12-13.

u_stop.text: Stop risky tasks and spacewalks; alert the crew medical officer now. Record when symptoms began and which eye is affected; do not wait for an eye scan.
u_stop.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; Team triage guide, SANS, medical urgency: initial action [P]

u_env.source: Edu-approved prototype workflow for #191 (2026-11-15): Earth contact required on ISS/Mars, optional on Moon; clinician-held urgency escalation and explicit insufficient-correction question. This is a team workflow decision, not a validated clinical rule.

u_mars_send.text: Send the case summary to the flight surgeons (mission doctors); this app does not send it. Continue local care without waiting for Earth; the clinician decides any return or transfer.
u_mars_send.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; stop/medical-assessment response [P]; communication context: https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/mars-communications-disruption-and-delay.pdf . No SANS evacuation rule is inferred. Edu-approved prototype workflow for #191 (2026-11-15): Earth contact required on ISS/Mars, optional on Moon; clinician-held urgency escalation and explicit insufficient-correction question. This is a team workflow decision, not a validated clinical rule.

u_ground.text: Send the case summary to the flight surgeons (mission doctors); this app does not send it. Continue local care without waiting for Earth; the clinician decides any return or transfer.
u_ground.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; stop/medical-assessment response [P]; communication context: https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/mars-communications-disruption-and-delay.pdf . No SANS evacuation rule is inferred. Edu-approved prototype workflow for #191 (2026-11-15): Earth contact required on ISS/Mars, optional on Moon; clinician-held urgency escalation and explicit insufficient-correction question. This is a team workflow decision, not a validated clinical rule.

u_end.text: Clinician review and transfer of care are recorded; follow medical limits and follow-up. This does not mean you are cured or cleared for spacewalks; any transfer is a medical and mission decision.
u_end.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; Team triage guide, SANS: implementation and closing rules [P]

u_help.text: Request immediate assistance from the crew medical officer. Do not continue the risky task.

w_concern.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), pp. 1-2; numerical concern requires priority review without automatic medical urgency [P].

w_priority_review.text: Ask the crew medical officer for priority medical review of the concerning finding. A concerning number alone does not establish a medical urgency.

w_missing_data.text: Tell the crew medical officer which eye results are unavailable or invalid. Arrange an assessment; without an eye scan, checks for changes inside the eye are incomplete.

u_local.text: Alert the on-board medical lead for an immediate eye, nerve and brain assessment. Do not assume every sudden vision problem is this spaceflight eye condition; the clinician decides care and limits.

u_support.text: Has the local clinician requested Earth support while local care continues?
u_support.source: Edu-approved prototype workflow for #191 (2026-11-15): Earth contact required on ISS/Mars, optional on Moon; clinician-held urgency escalation and explicit insufficient-correction question. This is a team workflow decision, not a validated clinical rule. Legacy node retained; now used for optional lunar Earth support.

u_handover.text: Confirm that a clinician has reviewed this episode and accepted responsibility for ongoing care. Select Done only then; otherwise keep this task active and stay assisted.

w_review_outcome.text: Wait here until the clinician completes the priority review. Has the clinician declared a medical urgency?
w_review_outcome.source: Edu-approved prototype workflow for #191 (2026-11-15): Earth contact required on ISS/Mars, optional on Moon; clinician-held urgency escalation and explicit insufficient-correction question. This is a team workflow decision, not a validated clinical rule.

w_symptoms.text: Do you have mild, gradual difficulty focusing or reading?
w_symptoms.source: Edu-approved prototype workflow for #191 (2026-11-15): Earth contact required on ISS/Mars, optional on Moon; clinician-held urgency escalation and explicit insufficient-correction question. This is a team workflow decision, not a validated clinical rule. Symptom wording: docs/sintomas_subjetivos_atrofia_SANS.md section 2.

w_correction_check.text: Has the clinician confirmed that the prescribed lenses you need go beyond the lens strengths available?
w_correction_check.source: Edu-approved prototype workflow for #191 (2026-11-15): Earth contact required on ISS/Mars, optional on Moon; clinician-held urgency escalation and explicit insufficient-correction question. This is a team workflow decision, not a validated clinical rule. Existing urgency criterion: w_red_flags; guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf p. 2.

u_no_clinician.text: Keep risky tasks stopped and follow your pre-authorized local emergency protocol without waiting for Earth. This episode stays open until a clinician reviews it and accepts care.
u_no_clinician.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; existing approved u_stop, u_local, u_mars_send and u_handover instructions: stop risky tasks, local pre-authorized emergency protocol without waiting for Earth, and clinician-accepted handover. #217 prototype flow composition [P]: show these existing instructions when handover cannot be accepted, then return to the open handover task. No new treatment, alternate clinician role, timer or autonomous closure.
